activity_summary: After playing Navarre you spoke briefly in the tiring-house with Richard Burbage and John Heminges after James walked off up Holywell Lane. All three agreed an unread five-year clause is no bargain, the timber wants pricing before any talk of pulling beams down, and your Act 3 king is still half a leaf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he would not curse a man he has not seen and noted Act 3 is still half a leaf.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Said his father walked off up Holywell Lane and backed Cuthbert on pricing the timber first.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Called an unread clause no bargain and refused to write any figure in his book.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Already halfway up Holywell Lane before the yard was dry.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: Brought Allen's heads Saturday and wanted the timber priced first.

entities.name: Giles Allen
entities.context: Landlord refusing to let anyone read the five-year clause.

entities.name: The Theatre
entities.context: Mentioned in Tiring-house exchange on Giles Allen's lease terms

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Tiring-house exchange on Giles Allen's lease terms

facets.activity: Spoke with Richard and Heminges after Navarre about Allen's lease

quotes.speaker: John Heminges
quotes.text: An unread clause is no bargain. A man who will not show his ink is asking us to sign blind.

quotes.speaker: William Shakespeare
quotes.text: Half a leaf of the third act, and three words on my tables. Long enough to keep him patient, and not a page more tonight.
